decisions: Minutes from the July 17, 2025 board meeting approved as amended with a correction to the Q2 revenue figures notation.

Escalation of collection process approved for two outstanding invoices totaling $320,000; Pierre Dubois authorized to engage external collections counsel if payment not received by September 15, 2025; Q3 revenue target of $5.1 million formally adopted.

Contract renewal negotiations with Northwind Partners approved; revised annual retainer to be proposed at $216,000 inclusive of Southeast Asian market entry analysis; Aiyana Park designated lead contact; renewal meeting to be scheduled by September 5, 2025; legal to prepare updated contract draft by August 29, 2025.

Technology infrastructure upgrade approved in principle; Aiyana Park to obtain minimum three vendor quotes for presentation at September board meeting; project start date tentatively set for October 6, 2025.

Revised talent retention policy approved; retention bonus structure effective January 1, 2026; professional development budget increased 30% effective Q4 2025; mentorship program pilot to begin October 1, 2025 under Aiyana Park.
Margaret Holvan and Aiyana Park to attend the Global Advisory Summit (September 9–11, 2025); next board meeting confirmed for September 18, 2025.
